modules.module_title: Prepare for maintenance and repair work

pcs.pc_description: inspect the mechanical systems and identify and document any existing issues or potential areas of concern
review the mechanical drawings, specifications and engineering plans, including HVAC drawings
conduct site survey to identify any constraints to repair and maintenance work
develop a maintenance plan outlining regular inspection schedules, preventive maintenance tasks, and a timeline for repairs

schedule and coordinate contractor visits, ensuring they are briefed on the scope of work and building protocols

modules.module_title: Supervise the maintenance and repair work

pcs.pc_description: ensure all necessary materials, tools, and equipment are available for the maintenance and repair work
review safety procedures and ensure all team members are aware of them
monitor the maintenance or repair work to ensure it is performed according to the maintenance plan and safety standards
identify and address any unforeseen issues that arise during the repair and maintenance process
conduct inspection of the completed work to ensure the mechanical systems work correctly
ensure the repair and maintenance work meets the applicable standards and specifications
perform functional tests on repaired or maintained systems to ensure they are working as intended.
implement improvements to enhance efficiency, safety, and reliability of mechanical systems
maintain detailed records of all maintenance and repair activities
provide reports to the building owner/ management, highlighting completed work, and any upgrade recommendations
